pr_title: fix: don't see files as hive partitions

issue_context.title: Extra column when file_name contains an "=" sign, after write_parquet and read_parquet
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
first_df = pl.DataFrame({"col_a": [0, 1, 2], "col_b": ["a", "b", "c"]})
print(first_df)
first_df.write_parquet("data=1.parquet")

second_df = pl.read_parquet("data=1.parquet")
print(second_df)
```
![image](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/assets/19366571/d7725a26-5e14-4a29-9a71-aed59d5fd899)

### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

### Context
After saving a file with an equal sign "=", and reloading it, we can observe an extra column. 

This issue does not happen when removing the equal sign "=" from the file name.
```python
first_df.write_parquet("data_1.parquet")

second_df = pl.read_parquet("data_1.parquet")
print(second_df)
```
![image](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/assets/19366571/fa484b24-2750-4deb-8925-40a8262b6909)

### Expected behavior

No extra column when saving a file with an equal sign.

~Set `hive_partitioning=False`.~

EDIT: Hmm.. this should only be triggered by directories, not  by filenames.

review_comments: I think you meant to put a "." here because it still picks up foo as a hive partition. That said, it's probably better to treat the last split as the file rather than trying to decide it's a file by its name.
